name: space-playground.scss
html:
<pre class="docs-code"><code class="lang-scss">// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  space-playground.scss — the Earth Playground route: a fullscreen Three.js
//  Earth/Moon canvas with a right-side "space panel" of WebGL sliders
//  (camera distance, sun position, atmosphere, FX). The panel is desktop-only
//  (≥1024px); on smaller screens the view is the canvas alone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../core/sass/base/placeholders';
@import '../../core/sass/base/structure';

// ── Space Playground view ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Full-screen immersive Earth/Moon background with a right-side controls panel.
// Controls panel visible on ≥ 1024 px only.

$_B_SP: 'sp';
$_B_SPP: '#{$_B_SP}-panel';

:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: transparent;
}

// The Three.js Earth canvas (fixed fullscreen behind the panel).
.#{$_B_SP}-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  z-index: 0;

  // Dead GL context after a failed boot — hidden so the CSS starfield
  // shows through instead of an opaque black framebuffer.
  &.is-fallback {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
}

// Static deep-space fallback — mounted when the engine can't boot
// (WebGL disallowed/unavailable, init failure). Keeps the route legible
// instead of leaving a black void.
.#{$_B_SP}-fallback {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 50% 62%, rgba($color-blue, 0.28) 0%, transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at center,
      rgba($color-blue, 0.3) 0%,
      rgba($color-black, 0.9) 60%,
      var(--bg-dark) 100%
    );
}

// ── Sci-Fi System Boot Loader overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────

@keyframes sp-spin-cw {
  to {
    rotate: 360deg;
  }
}

@keyframes sp-spin-ccw {
  to {
    rotate: -360deg;
  }
}

// Boot loader overlay — stays up until the first usable frame renders.
.#{$_B_SP}-loader {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  pointer-events: auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
  transition:
    opacity 0.8s ease-in-out,
    filter 0.8s ease-in-out;

  &-glow {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(
      circle at center,
      rgba($color-blue, 0.4) 0%,
      rgba($color-black, 0.9) 60%,
      rgba($color-black, 1) 100%
    );
  }

  &-grid {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(to right, rgba($color-white, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba($color-white, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
      ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%,
      var(--bg-dark) 70%,
      transparent 100%
    );
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%, var(--bg-dark) 70%, transparent 100%);
  }

  &-content {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  &-spinner-outer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
    width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    height: to-rem($space-8xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    border: 1px solid rgba($color-white, 0.1);
    border-top-color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
    border-right-color: rgba($color-white, 0.3);
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-left-color: transparent;
    animation: sp-spin-cw 8s linear infinite;
  }

  &-spinner-inner {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
    width: to-rem($space-9xl);
    height: to-rem($space-9xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    border: 1px solid rgba($color-white, 0.05);
    border-bottom-color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    animation: sp-spin-ccw 12s linear infinite;
  }

  &-counter {
    width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    height: to-rem($space-4xl);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  &-percent {
    @extend .ttl-md;

    font-weight: 300;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.9);
  }

  &-sym {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    margin-left: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xs);
  }

  &-msg {
    @extend .txt-xs;

    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    line-height: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  &-bar {
    width: to-rem($space-9xl);
    height: 1px;
    background-color: rgba($color-white, 0.1);
    margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;

    &-fill {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 0%;
      background-color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
      transition: width 0.2s ease-out;
    }
  }
}

// ── Controls wrapper & panel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Right-side controls column (desktop ≥1024px).
.#{$_B_SP}-controls-wrap {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  position: absolute;
  top: to-rem($space-3xl);
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

// The controls panel — sliders, checkboxes and action buttons grouped in sections.
.#{$_B_SPP} {
  display: none; // hidden on mobile

  @include layout-1024() {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    pointer-events: auto;
    width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    max-height: calc(100vh - to-rem($space-5xl));
    overflow-y: auto;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: var(--border-color) transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
    background: var(--glass-bg);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xl));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xl));
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    transition:
      transform 0.3s ease,
      opacity 0.3s ease;
  }

  &--collapsed {
    transform: translateX(calc(100% + to-rem($space-3xl)));
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
  }

  &-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-lg);
    border-bottom: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  &-title {
    font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    margin: 0;
  }

  &-toggle {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    line-height: 1;
    padding: 0;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;

    &:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
  }

  &-body {
    padding: to-rem($space-md);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  &-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    overflow: hidden;

    &-header {
      @extend %RESETBTN;

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: to-rem($space-sm);
      width: 100%;
      padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
      border-bottom: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
      color: inherit;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;

      &:hover,
      &:focus-visible {
        background: var(--bg-primary);
      }

      &:focus-visible {
        @include focus-ring;
        outline-offset: to-rem(-$space-2xs);
      }
    }

    &-chevron {
      font-size: to-rem($space-md);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    &-label {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      font-family: var(--font-ui);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    &-content {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: to-rem($space-xs);
      padding: to-rem($space-sm);
      transition:
        max-height 0.3s ease,
        opacity 0.3s ease;
      max-height: to-rem($space-10xl);
      opacity: 1;
    }

    // Collapsed state
    &--collapsed {
      .#{$_B_SPP}-group-chevron {
        transform: rotate(0deg);
      }

      .#{$_B_SPP}-group-content {
        max-height: 0;
        opacity: 0;
        padding: 0 to-rem($space-sm);
        overflow: hidden;
      }
    }

    // Expanded chevron
    &:not(.#{$_B_SPP}-group--collapsed) {
      .#{$_B_SPP}-group-chevron {
        transform: rotate(90deg);
      }
    }
  }

  &-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) 0;
    font-size: to-rem(15);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-family: var(--font-ui);

    &-label {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      min-width: to-rem($space-6xl);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-size: to-rem(15);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    &-ctrl {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: to-rem($space-md);
      flex: 1;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    &--check {
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
  }

  &-range {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: to-rem($space-xs);
    background: transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    outline: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 0;

    &::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
      height: to-rem($space-xs);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      background: linear-gradient(
        to right,
        var(--color-accent-contrast) 0%,
        var(--color-accent-contrast) var(--range-pct, 50%),
        var(--border-color) var(--range-pct, 50%),
        var(--border-color) 100%
      );
    }

    &::-moz-range-track {
      height: to-rem($space-xs);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      background: var(--border-color);
    }

    &::-moz-range-progress {
      height: to-rem($space-xs);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      background: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    }

    &::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      appearance: none;
      width: to-rem($space-lg);
      height: to-rem($space-lg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      background: var(--color-accent-contrast);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--bg-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-xs) var(--color-accent-contrast);
      cursor: pointer;
      margin-top: calc(-1 * (#{to-rem($space-lg)} - #{to-rem($space-xs)}) / 2);
      transition:
        transform 0.15s ease,
        box-shadow 0.15s ease;

      &:hover {
        transform: scale(1.2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-md) var(--color-accent-contrast);
      }

      &:active {
        transform: scale(1.3);
        box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-lg) var(--color-accent-contrast);
      }
    }

    &::-moz-range-thumb {
      width: to-rem($space-lg);
      height: to-rem($space-lg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      background: var(--color-accent-contrast);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--bg-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-xs) var(--color-accent-contrast);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition:
        transform 0.15s ease,
        box-shadow 0.15s ease;

      &:hover {
        transform: scale(1.2);
        box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-md) var(--color-accent-contrast);
      }

      &:active {
        transform: scale(1.3);
        box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-lg) var(--color-accent-contrast);
      }
    }
  }

  &-check {
    &-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: to-rem(22);
      height: to-rem(22);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    &-input {
      position: absolute;
      opacity: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    &-box {
      position: relative;
      width: to-rem(20);
      height: to-rem(20);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition:
        border-color 0.2s ease,
        background-color 0.2s ease,
        box-shadow 0.2s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;

      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-3xs);
        height: to-rem($space-3xs);
        transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: -1px;
        left: -1px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--color-accent-contrast);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--color-accent-contrast);
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: -1px;
        right: -1px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-accent-contrast);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--color-accent-contrast);
      }
    }

    &-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: inherit;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    &-icon {
      position: relative;
      width: to-rem(13);
      height: to-rem(13);
      fill: none;
      stroke: var(--color-accent-contrast);
      stroke-width: 2.2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
      stroke-dasharray: 20;
      stroke-dashoffset: 20;
      transform: scale(0.7);
      opacity: 0;
      transition:
        stroke-dashoffset 0.22s ease-out,
        transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28),
        opacity 0.15s ease;
      z-index: 2;
    }
  }

  // Checkbox hover state
  &-check-wrapper:hover &-check-box {
    border-color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-xs)
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-contrast) 35%, transparent);
  }

  // Checkbox checked state
  &-check-input:checked + &-check-box {
    border-color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-contrast) 20%, transparent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 to-rem($space-sm)
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent-contrast) 50%, transparent);

    .#{$_B_SPP}-check-icon {
      stroke-dashoffset: 0;
      transform: scale(1);
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  &-val {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem(14);
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    font-weight: 700;
    min-width: to-rem($space-3xl);
    text-align: right;
    user-select: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }

  &-readout {
    font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
    font-size: to-rem(14);
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-sm);
    white-space: pre;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  &-action-wrap {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) 0;
  }

  &-btn {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    width: auto;
    min-width: to-rem(180);
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-3xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-none);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-size: to-rem(15);
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition:
      color 0.2s ease,
      opacity 0.2s ease;

    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-md);
      height: to-rem($space-md);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        height 0.25s ease;
    }

    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--text-primary);
      border-left: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--text-primary);
    }

    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--text-primary);
      border-right: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--text-primary);
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus,
    &[aria-pressed='true'] {
      color: var(--color-accent-contrast);

      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        border-color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── Floating reopen button (Experience Settings) ─────────────────────────────
// Styled identically to .expand-modal-open-1 with animated corner borders.

// Reopen-panel button shown when the panel is collapsed.
.#{$_B_SP}-reopen {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  display: none; // managed by JS; shown on desktop when panel is collapsed

  @include layout-1024() {
    position: relative;
    pointer-events: auto;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
    // Floats over the always-dark space scene — fixed light ink, not
    // --text-primary (dark in light mode → invisible on the canvas).
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    background: transparent;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-2xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-2xs));
    transition:
      color 0.2s ease,
      opacity 0.2s ease;

    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-md);
      height: to-rem($space-md);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        height 0.25s ease;
    }

    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--color-white-raw);
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      color: var(--color-accent);

      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        border-color: var(--color-accent);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ── Native audio player bar aligned with nav ─────────────────────────────────

// Music toggle button.
.#{$_B_SP}-music {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  position: absolute;
  bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
  left: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  pointer-events: none;

  audio {
    pointer-events: auto;
    height: to-rem($space-2xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    opacity: 0.85;
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}
